lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ihu kaaran karataa kare jotee jot samaai ||4||3||5||
lines.translation: This deed was done by the Creator Lord; one's light merges into the Light. ||4||3||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam raam sabh ko kahai kahiai raam na hoi ||
lines.translation: Everyone chants the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam; but by such chanting, the Lord is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee raam man vasai taa phal paavai koi ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, the fruits are obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar govi(n)d jis laagai preet ||
lines.translation: One who enshrines love for God within his mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tis kade na veesarai har har karahi sadaa man cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: never forgets the Lord; he continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in his conscious mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai jinh kai kapat vasai baaharahu sa(n)t kahaahi ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with hypocrisy, who are called saints only for their outward show

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa mool na chukaee a(n)t gae pachhutaahi ||2||
lines.translation: - their desires are never satisfied, and they depart grieving in the end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anek teerath je jatan karai taa a(n)tar kee haumai kade na jaai ||
lines.translation: Although one may bathe at many places of pilgrimage, still, his ego never departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis nar kee dubidhaa na jaai dharam raai tis dei sajaai ||3||
lines.translation: That man, whose sense of duality does not depart - the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall punish him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam hovai soee jan paae guramukh boojhai koee ||
lines.translation: That humble being, unto whom God showers His Mercy, obtains Him; how few are the Gurmukhs who understand Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vichahu haumai maare taa(n) har bhetai soee ||4||4||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one conquers his ego within, then he comes to meet the Lord. ||4||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis jan saa(n)t sadaa mat nihachal jis kaa abhimaan gavaae ||
lines.translation: That humble being who eliminates his ego is at peace; he is blessed with an ever-stable intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so jan niramal j guramukh boojhai har charanee chit laae ||1||
lines.translation: That humble being is immaculately pure, who, as Gurmukh, understands the Lord, and focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har chet achet manaa jo ichhahi so phal hoee ||
lines.translation: O my unconscious mind, remain conscious of the Lord, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੀਵਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras paavahi peevat rahahi sadaa sukh hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the sublime elixir of the Lord; by continually drinking it in, you shall have eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhete taa paaras hovai paaras hoi ta pooj karaae ||
lines.translation: When one meets the True Guru, he becomes the philosopher's stone, with the ability to transform others, inspiring them to worship the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਸੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo us pooje so phal paae deekhiaa devai saach bujhaae ||2||
lines.translation: One who worships the Lord in adoration, obtains his rewards; instructing others, he reveals the Truth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਸੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨ ਪਰਚੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin paarasai pooj na hovaee vin man parache avaraa samajhaae ||
lines.translation: Without becoming the philosopher's stone, he does not inspire others to worship the Lord; without instructing his own mind, how can he instruct others?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਏ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guroo sadaae agiaanee a(n)dhaa kis ohu maarag paae ||3||
lines.translation: The ignorant, blind man calls himself the guru, but to whom can he show the way? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin nadaree kichhoo na paaeeai jis nadar kare so paae ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without His Mercy, nothing can be obtained. One upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, obtains Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee de vadiaaee apanaa sabad varataae ||4||5||7||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, God bestows greatness, and projects the Word of His Shabad. ||4||5||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 pa(n)chapade ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Third Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa kaasee mat oopajai naa kaasee mat jaai ||
lines.translation: Wisdom is not produced in Benares, nor is wisdom lost in Benares.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai mat oopajai taa ih sojhee paai ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, wisdom is produced, and then, one obtains this understanding. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kathaa too(n) sun re man sabad ma(n)n vasaai ||
lines.translation: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, O mind, and enshrine the Shabad of His Word within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih mat teree thir rahai taa(n) bharam vichahu jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If your intellect remains stable and steady, then doubt shall depart from within you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan ridai vasaai too kilavikh hovahi naas ||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet within your heart, and your sins shall be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoo aatamaa vas karahi taa teerath karahi nivaas ||2||
lines.translation: If your soul overcomes the five elements, then you shall come to have a home at the true place of pilgrimage. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ihu man mugadh hai sojhee kichhoo na paai ||
lines.translation: This mind of the self-centered manmukh is so stupid; it does not obtain any understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam na bujhaee a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaai ||3||
lines.translation: It does not understand the Name of the Lord; it departs repenting in the end. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man kaasee sabh teerath simrit satigur deeaa bujhaai ||
lines.translation: In this mind are found Benares, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the Shaastras; the True Guru has explained this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath tis sa(n)g rahahi jin har hiradai rahiaa samaai ||4||
lines.translation: The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage remain with one, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur miliai hukam bujhiaa ek vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, upon meeting the True Guru, the Order of the Lord's Will is understood, and the One Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai sabh sach hai sache rahai samaai ||5||6||8||
lines.translation: Those who are pleasing to You, O True Lord, are true. They remain absorbed in You. ||5||6||8||
